message: ヘレナのご褒美
Separate from Crusaders activities, I patrol the academy grounds on my own. Out of all the places here, the cultural hall is the least familiar to us students.
I've been in and out of it plenty of times for elections and student assemblies, but it isn't an everyday space like a classroom or the Student Council room.
Because of that, everything around me feels fresh whenever I come here, giving me a healthy sense of tension.

name: Helena
message: 「Ka-boooooom!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, it's Helena! Looks like it's just the two of us here in the cultural hall, Synn-chan\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why on earth did you come crawling out from under the seats?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, you see, if I'm being honest, I'd love to use actual explosives, but I'm sure the fire department wouldn't approve it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's actually have a normal conversation here, Helena-san!」

name: Helena
message: 「Jeez, Synn-chan, nagging at me just like Ria does. That makes big sis so happy!」

name: Synn
message: 「Happy, not sad?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, because that girl is graduating next March, after all.」

name: Helena
message: 「Even if our bond as sisters remains, once she stops coming to the academy, she'll have fewer chances to rattle off her lectures at me.」

name: Helena
message: 「It's a little lonely, you know...」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san...」

name: Helena
message: 「That's why I'm going to liven things up at the very end with a huge, shocking surprise♪」

name: Helena
message: 「Mmm-hmm! I bet I can rig all sorts of things into the seats. Plus I can tamper with the stage curtain, and loads of other stuff--」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What are you talking about?」

name: Helena
message: 「An evil scheme\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, first things first, I'll have you and the others wrap up that whole Re-Crea business nice and quick--」

name: Synn
message: 「How wildly optimistic.」

name: Helena
message: 「And then! Since everything should be resolved by the graduation ceremony...」

name: Helena
message: 「Right in the middle of the ceremony, I'm going to pull off the ultimate prank! Not just on Ria, either--on all the third-years♪」

name: Synn
message: 「I-If you do something like that, the principal and vice principal are going to be furious!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, aren't the third-years the stars of the graduation ceremony?」

name: Helena
message: 「I want to pull a prank on all of them that'll stay with them for the rest of their lives...」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu. Think of it as a reward for myself, the commander of the Ryuusei Crusaders♪」

name: Synn
message: 「That sounds nice... I wish you'd do something like that for me, too」

name: Helena
message: 「Hey now! It's still way too early for a second-year like you, Synn-chan?」

name: Helena
message: 「Of course, I'm already thinking up graduation pranks for you, Nanaka-chan, and Misa-chan too」

name: Helena
message: 「And as for what kind of prank it'll be--」

name: Synn
message: 「Waaaah~!! Please don't spoil it!!」
I cover my ears with both hands and dash out of the assembly hall. Glancing back toward Helena-san just before exiting, I see a beaming smile on her face.
Yeah, I may not know every single one of the third-years, but they're the ones who elected me as Student Council President.
To live up to their expectations, I have to stop Re-Crea and make sure they make it safely to their graduation ceremony!
